plan: behind2 (game/probe/unit_probe.py BH2_*; tmp/melee_core/v2/critic_review.md 7, the orchestrator's order of 15.11 night)
what: The behind lane (clanrats_0 E, fearless, attack our anvil A - Empire spearmen, morale kept, never ordered - at a run from 200 m; our swordsmen B, morale kept) on other geometries: b24 / b36 the anvil 24 / 36 m wide against E's 30 (B's centre 20 m straight behind A's, attacks E at a run 8 s after A's first melee flag), h24 / h36 / h30 the same with B never ordered, b30 the behind lane; half - B killed to 60 men at placement (kill_number_of_men 0.5, the same 30 m front: the probe's only way to a smaller unit of one template - the scenes' worn men go through armies.description, which the probe entry has not); two - B straight behind and C (swordsmen, an extra keeping its morale) on A's line 48 m aside, both at 8 s (the entry's new extra option go_melee_s); side - B on A's line 48 m aside alone; b30L / h30L read to 480 s; lower priority bnear / b40 / att / att_h. The long lanes' A and B are fearless (the others keep their morale, as behind). Battles 1-6: h24 b24 h36 b36 h30 b30; 7-12: h30 b30 half two side two (22 units with the clock's lords); 13-14: (h30L b30L) x 3; 15-16: h30 b30 bnear b40 att att_h; kinds rotated over 6 places, the beside units' side mirrored between battles; 100 ms engine step wanted (<= 22 units, <= 2642 men).
measures: Per-man rows from memory (memreader, mem_extras: A, B, C and E bound) every 0.1 s while B and E are within 105 m before the contact, every 0.5 s after it - the behind plan's rows. A start: a living man present in two consecutive polls whose strike mark rose, given to the unit owning the man in his tgt at the later poll. In reach: a living enemy man within 4.0 m (centres). t: s from A's first melee flag (unit samples); tau: s from the joiner's own first melee flag ('two': the earlier of B's and C's - R4's oldest junior). A rate: starts over the span of the polls in the window. 'Over hold': over the mean of the same-width hold lanes (h24 / h30 / h36 / h30L, B never ordered) of the same pair's rate in the same seconds from their A flag. Mean +- one standard error over lanes; 'within two errors of N (+- e)': |m - N| <= 2 sqrt(se^2 + e^2). Code: tmp/probe_night2/ext.py, series.py, tlib.py, tables.py (tmp/sim_behind/lane_series.py's definitions: the numbers compare with behind's tab1 / chk_tables). Losses: game/probe/unit_probe.py behind2_measure (behind_measure's windows 30 / 60 / 120 / 240 s from the sample before the lane's first flag, + 480 on the long lanes).

verdict.L1: THE CORNERS COUNT. B>E starts a second at t 60-120 s: b24 1.686 +- 0.059 (6), b30 1.117 +- 0.126 (14), b36 0.900 +- 0.107 (6) against 0.96 +- 0.08: b24 is 3.6 times its two errors away, b30 and b36 inside. B's men in reach 13.3 / 9.2 / 8.0, of them beyond A's two ends 10.4 / 3.2 / 0.1; v (over the same width's hold A in reach 30.3 / 36.0 / 43.7) 0.44 / 0.255 / 0.18. A narrower anvil leaves E's corners free and B fills them (the frames: B wraps round A's 24 m front); a wider one hides B's corners but B still reaches ~8 men through A's line. The relief follows: x at tau 45-105 s 0.365 +- 0.016 / 0.291 +- 0.032 / 0.260 +- 0.019. S2's floor cannot be a constant share of the anvil's line: it needs the free corners (E's front beyond A's), and the relief x too depends on them.
verdict.L2: R4'S TOTAL, THE PRODUCT'S RELIEF. E's total at t 60-120 s over h30's E>A: two 1.062 +- 0.010 (12), b30 1.038 +- 0.012, side 1.069 +- 0.017 - inside 1.00-1.10 and 8.8 errors below 1.15: by the line, R4 (the total stays). But A's relief with two joiners is x 0.457 +- 0.032 against b30's 0.293 and side's 0.266; the product 1 - (1 - 0.293)(1 - 0.266) = 0.481 is within one error, R4's 'the senior keeps 1 - x(tau_o)' (0.29) is five errors away. The juniors each take nearly their lone share (E>B 0.245 +- 0.031, E>C 0.274 +- 0.012 of hold's E>A, alone 0.331 / 0.335), not y split by men. So: E's blows are conserved and each junior draws its own share off the senior - R4 must be rewritten: the senior keeps 1 - sum of the juniors' takes (+ the small excess), the juniors' takes ~0.8 of their lone y; the design's product is right for A, wrong for E's total.
verdict.L3: CONSTANT SHARE (6 lanes, wide error). x at tau 45-105 s: half 0.309 +- 0.065, b30 0.291 +- 0.032 (ratio 1.06) with B's living men over A's 0.58 against 1.21; within 0.24 +- max(0.04, two errors), 2.9 errors from 0.12. y the same (0.331 against 0.334): a half-size B takes as many of E's blows as a full one and loses about the same health (0.192 of its own at 120 s against the full B's 0.094). R5 (i)'s factor min(1, men_j / men_a) is not supported down to half; its ramp is slower (x 0.07 / 0.08 / 0.16 at tau 0-5 / 5-15 / 15-30 against 0.10 / 0.17 / 0.24) - by bin, not by level.
verdict.L4: FLAT, BY A HAIR, AND NOT TO 480 s. b30L x at tau 165-240 s 0.392 +- 0.038, at tau 240-T_end 0.323 +- 0.030 (T_end 303-310 s: the hold anvil falls under 20 men at t 321 s, h30L A is one thin rank of ~28 at t 290 s), later - earlier -0.069 +- 0.037 (6): inside two errors (0.074), leaning down. The 165-240 value is above the table's 0.33 by 1.6 errors. A 480 s read needs a lane whose hold anvil lives that long (a stronger or deeper anvil) - not run.
